description: The file defines the Java class LogicTransform, which represents transformations applied to logic criteria within the OpenMRS healthcare framework. It includes properties for operators, result limits, and sorting, along with methods to access, modify, and compare these properties.

classes.name: LogicTransform
classes.description: Represents a transformation applied to logic criteria, such as counting results, taking the first few results, or ordering results by a specific column. It encapsulates the operator, number of results, and sorting column.

methods.name: LogicTransform
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transform with an operator and a specific number of results.

methods.name: LogicTransform
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transform with only an operator, without specifying number of results.

methods.name: getTransformOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used for the transformation.

methods.name: getNumResults
methods.description: Returns the number of results to be returned, applicable for 'First' and 'Last' operators.

methods.name: getSortColumn
methods.description: Returns the column used for sorting the results.

methods.name: setNumResults
methods.description: Sets the number of results to be returned.

methods.name: setSortColumn
methods.description: Sets the column used for sorting.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transformation, including operator, result count, and sort column if set.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on operator, number of results, and sorting column.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the LogicTransform object.
